newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Svedala wins Iran order for 550 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: Svedala wins Iran order for 550 mln skr.

text.p: Swedish mining equipment company Svedala Industri AB said on Monday it won an order worth 550 million crowns from Miduk Consolidated Copper Mines of Iran.
The order includes equipment for a new Miduk copper mine in the Kerman region in southeast Iran, Svedala said in a statement.
"The capacity at the concentration plant will be 45,000 tonnes of copper," Svedala said.
Deliveries will take place in 1998 and 1999 and operation is due to begin in 2000, Svedala said.

Svedala announced a contract earlier this year from the National Iranian Copper Industries Co to expand and modernise the Sarchesmeh mine in southeast Iran, an order worth 700 million crowns. This was Svedala's biggest order ever.
